title: Preliminary baseline evaluation
summary: A fixed 25-question baseline was run against current read-only production retrieval, and a reviewer packet plus structured scoresheet are ready.
evidence: Answerability decision matched the expected behavior for 16 of 25 questions.
Citation rule satisfied for 25 of 25 questions.
Mean retrieval latency was 208.31 milliseconds and P95 was 771.87 milliseconds.
Largest gaps appeared in agent attraction, paid lead-source comparison, CRM specifics, open-house greetings, and follow-up scripts.
The private reviewer packet contains all 25 answers, cited excerpts, a six-dimension rubric, and reviewer fields.
No production question records were created and the production service remained healthy.
limitations: Auto-scores are preliminary. FFM subject-matter review and independent verification are required before gate approval.
